flags.title: Brock is too hard for an average player
flags.detail: First-try win rate 25% (target 55-75%). Onix's Bind plus Rock Tomb outpaces the starter's TP budget; Charmander wins only 2%.
flags.suggestion: Try Onix L12, or let Charmander learn Metal Claw-equivalent coverage earlier

flags.title: Sabrina is a wall for average players
flags.detail: Psychic-types resist everything the party has; win rate far under target.
flags.suggestion: Lower Alakazam to L41 or give the player a Ghost/Bug option earlier

flags.title: Butterfree dominates stages 4 to 6
flags.detail: Rating 1810 with Sleep Powder plus Psybeam; usage in winning teams 31%.
flags.suggestion: Raise Sleep Powder TP cost 8 to 10

flags.title: TP runs out before Rock Tunnel
flags.detail: Average player has 14 battles per rest but only 6 TP-worth of moves (target 8-15 battles).
flags.suggestion: Add an inn at Shion or lower mid-rank move costs

flags.title: Hideout boss under target
flags.detail: Kangaskhan lasts 11 turns on average; items used 2.1 per attempt.
flags.suggestion: Lower Kangaskhan to L27

flags.title: Sleep is a free win
flags.detail: Teams with a sleep move win 24% more often across stages 3 to 7.
flags.suggestion: Cap sleep at 2 turns or raise TP cost

flags.title: Ember is dominant at 7 TP
flags.detail: Damage per TP 3.1 vs median 1.9; delta win 18%.
flags.suggestion: Raise Ember TP to 9 or lower power to 35

flags.title: Misty depends heavily on starter choice
flags.detail: Charmander wins 18%, Bulbasaur 63%.
flags.suggestion: Add a Route 3 Electric/Grass option or raise Staryu's level

flags.title: Lance's Dragonite out-damages the whole party
flags.detail: Hyper Beam two-shots most of the average party.
flags.suggestion: Lower Dragonite to L60 or add TP drain

flags.title: Brock arrives with 0.4 TP left on average
flags.detail: tp_left_at_gym 0.40 (target 0.5 to 1.0).
flags.suggestion: Add a rest point on Route 2

flags.title: Alakazam over-performs for skilled players
flags.detail: Rating 1990, 2.9 sigma above the stage mean.
flags.suggestion: Increase Recover TP cost

flags.title: Surge is a pushover
flags.detail: Win rate 95% (target 55-75%): Ground-type access trivialises the gym.
flags.suggestion: Add Magnemite L22 or Raichu Thunder Wave

flags.title: Player is 4 levels behind the foes
flags.detail: Mean player level 31.5 vs foe 36.0.
flags.suggestion: Lower trainer levels or add EXP Share equivalent

flags.title: Surf out-scales every alternative
flags.detail: Used 83% of turns by Water-types that learn it.
flags.suggestion: Raise TP cost 12 to 14

flags.title: Potion price too low for what it buys
flags.detail: Delta win 0.2 per 1000 yen, double that of the next item.
flags.suggestion: Price Potion at 400

flags.title: Provoke wins Misty outright
flags.detail: Resolute state triggers on 71% of Provokes.
flags.suggestion: Add a Resolute counter-chance for gym leaders

flags.title: Kingler has no good place in the curve
flags.detail: Win rate 42% below the median species.
flags.suggestion: Check Crabhammer accuracy and learn level

flags.title: Rival at Nibi hits slightly hard
flags.detail: Pidgeotto's Wing Attack chains with Quick Attack.
flags.suggestion: Drop the second Rattata to L9

flags.title: Hiker Anthony hits above his class
flags.detail: Three Rock/Ground mons in a row; win rate 68%.
flags.suggestion: Swap Onix for Geodude

flags.title: Magmar is outclassed everywhere
flags.detail: Only 0.8% pick rate; every stage has a better Fire-type.
flags.suggestion: Give Magmar a signature move

flags.title: Special action never beats a plain attack
flags.detail: Special used in 2% of turns.
flags.suggestion: Revisit Pikachu's special

flags.title: Wrap is a dead move
flags.detail: Chosen 0.4% of turns; delta win -3%.
flags.suggestion: Rework Wrap into a TP-drain move

flags.title: Koga easy for skilled players
flags.detail: Skilled band wins 99% with Talk/Unnerve.
flags.suggestion: Consider a Panic-resistant AI state

flags.title: Brock outcome is decided by crits
flags.detail: 36% of losses involve two or more critical hits.
flags.suggestion: Reduce Onix crit chance

flags.title: Skilled players over-level Mt. Moon
flags.suggestion: Fine

flags.title: Full Restore never bought
flags.detail: 0% of simulated runs buy it before the Plateau.
flags.suggestion: Lower price to 2500

flags.title: Geodude is picked too rarely
flags.detail: Usage 4% across teams despite good matchups.
flags.suggestion: None needed; team policy may under-pick Rock types

flags.title: Escape Rope has no use in the simulator
flags.detail: Never used; the simulator has no dungeon navigation.
flags.suggestion: Ignore: simulator limitation
